Name: MitigationAssistant
Description: Tracks Mitigation usage and analyzes combat data and visualizes it
Punchline: I'll write this later - bet I'll forget
Changelog:
0.2.7 - Rewrite: find out why your party died

The plugin is rebuilt from scratch. Every pull is recorded; after a wipe, type /ma.

- Battle Timeline: every enemy attack, death and raise, including deaths without damage (walls, knockbacks).
- Attack details: damage per player, physical or magical, barriers, and every mitigation that was up and who used it.
- Death details: the killing hit, the last seconds of damage and healing, and the mitigation they had.
- Positions: where everyone stood on each attack, and a Position Timeline to play the pull back (instanced duties only).
- Players: every mitigation, barrier and heal each player used and what it did.
- What-if preview: remove or add mitigations and see who would have lived.
- Notes: /ma note <text> marks a moment; between pulls it goes to the end of the last pull.
